identification: Patinated bronze (or spelter) figure of a boy playing diabolo (spool on a string held aloft), signed 'L.B. Diabolo' per catalogue, on a round plinth, 40 cm; matches a modern reproduction design sold as 'LB Diabolo'

entries.note: Same subject and signature, 16 in with marble base, but the dealer states it is a REPRODUCTION. Armitage piece may be an old casting or a modern one; check. aud_price blank rather than converting.

searches_tried: | chrome: web: bronze sculpture signed L'B diabolo; diabolo boy bronze L.B. signed spelter. Found one dealer page (reproduction, asking). Original sculptor not identified.
viewing_check: Test with a magnet (spelter is soft grey metal, bronze is non-magnetic and heavy), look for a foundry stamp, check the base for modern screws and the patina for wear to a silvery metal.
